LGA: Initialism of large for gestational age.
LGBT: Being lesbian, gay, bisexual, or transgender, or relating to these groups as a collective.
LGBTQ: Initialism of lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer.
LGBTQIA: Initialism of lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender/transsexual, queer/questioning, intersex, and allied/allies/asexual/ar
